actionable_steps.step: Give with reverence and a single motive — the grace of the Lord — not for name, fame or publicity.

actionable_steps.citation: Combine morals with business — SSS Vol 17 (1984), 1984-05-14
actionable_steps.step: Keep your gifts within your means — neither beyond your financial capacity nor below it.

actionable_steps.citation: Combine morals with business — SSS Vol 17 (1984), 1984-05-14
actionable_steps.step: Share your time, skills and knowledge too — charity is not money alone.

actionable_steps.citation: Combine morals with business — SSS Vol 17 (1984), 1984-05-14
actionable_steps.step: Match your giving to the need in front of you — feed the hungry, clothe the naked.
When you feed someone, do it as Narayana Seva — an offering of gratitude to God, with love and humility, never pride.

definition.citation: Total Awareness Is Wisdom — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-04-12
definition.quote: For people, charity is the only true ornament for the hand. The ornament for the neck is truth, and for the ear it is righteousness. No ornaments are superior to these.

discourses.citation: Eradicate Immorality To Attain Immortality — SSS Vol 33 (2000), 2000-09-10
discourses.quote: In this world, there are many people who would give away wealth and other materialistic acquisitions in charity. But true charity lies in offering oneself to the Lord.

discourses.citation: Combine morals with business — SSS Vol 17 (1984), 1984-05-14
discourses.quote: Charity is not limited to money alone. One must share one's physical, mental and spiritual resources with those in need in society. It is through such sharing and sacrifice that the awareness of the Spirit (Atma jnana) is achieved.

When one parts with some money to someone who has come to him seeking assistance, the money that is given should not be regarded as charity or sacrifice, but as discharging of a preexisting obligation.

It is not dhana (charity) that you do; you are only offering gratitude to God; you are sanctifying the grain you have harvested by offering the food prepared out of it to these Narayanas (Gods in human form). Call it Narayana Seva!

make_it_real: Your hands are only truly beautiful when they are giving — make today beautiful.
title: Charity

vahinis.quote: Gifts made with that one end in view, to receive the grace of the Lord, are good (sathwic). Gifts made expecting something in return, like fame and publicity, public esteem, and power, or gifts made in a huff or made reluctantly under pressure —these are to be classed as passionate (rajasic).
